description: E3 (audit 2026-07): fixed-budget composition curve. mode=replace only (total train budget approximately constant, composition varies), nominal N=200, ratios {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1}, fixed_stratified_test (same frozen small+large test rows for every ratio and seed), per_structure loss weighting, 3 seeds (selection AND model init: the sweep seed now overrides any hyperparam seed, see test_parallel_sweep_seed_overrides_payload_hyperparam_seed). Reduced from ml_vs_siesta_mixing_sweep_20_500_stratified_per_structure_payload.json per the audit's E3 design. Per-domain H metrics (h_mae_eV_by_domain / macro / worst) are emitted since the 2026-07 pipeline fix, so the small-vs-large trade-off is measurable. action=preview by default: switch to "train" to launch.

notes.design: 5 ratios x 3 seeds x 2 models = 30 trainings when launched. Acceptance per audit E3: a ratio is Pareto-superior if it lowers the large-domain error without raising the small-domain error beyond ~10%; judge on h_mae_eV_by_domain, macro_domain and worst_domain, never on the pooled mean alone.
notes.composition_axes: Report the curve against real composition (snapshot fraction, atom fraction, matrix-element fraction from the materialize composition summary), not only the nominal ratio.
notes.concurrency_note: 2/2 training concurrency: measured peak VRAM 10-12 GB per training (5x5 campaign telemetry) on a 32 GB GPU; the 7/5 preset would overcommit.
notes.no_legacy_mixing: Do not pool these records with legacy_elementwise runs; weighting policies differ.
